messages:
marta: Heads-up — my contractor end date is 2026-05-14 (confirmed). Need guidance on benefits wrap, COBRA-equivalent, laptop return shipping, and SSO cutover.

kelsey: Thanks Marta. Lia (benefits) owns vendor notice. Linda (finance) confirms expense/payout timelines. IT bot will need manager approval if you need access after last day.

lia-benefits: Vendor feed shows coverage until 2026-05-31. I'll send termination to the vendor today; they should provide continuation options (vendor-run COBRA-equivalent) within ~7 business days.

linda-finance: Final payroll cutoff for a 5/14 termination is 2026-05-08. Submit receipts by 2026-05-06 to make the final run. We cover prepaid return shipping for international contractors; please paste tracking after ship.

adrian-manager: If Marta needs two extra days for handoff, I approve. approve access exception

it-ops-bot: IT ticket IT-2026-599 created: temporary SSO exception for marta.martinez until 2026-05-16 23:59 UTC. Reminder: tokens/keys and 3rd-party service access will be revoked at exception end unless explicitly whitelisted.

marta: Thanks all — I'll upload receipts tonight and ship the laptop tomorrow. Will post tracking here. Appreciate the quick coordination.
